reason: A chat input file-browser plugin that lets users navigate directories and insert selected file or directory paths as plain-text @ references.

summaries.zh: 在聊天输入框中通过 @ 浏览文件和目录，并将选中的路径以纯文本引用插入消息。
summaries.en: Browse files and directories with @ in the chat input and insert selected paths as plain-text references.

capabilities: lists files and directories from user-specified workspace or filesystem paths
serves directory listings through a local host route
inserts selected paths as plain text into the chat input
